Projects.Title: Gacha Nebula +
Projects.Summary: A new chapter in character creation.
Projects.Description: Create characters and build Studio scenes with Gacha Nebula +. This release adds saving, backup and stability improvements to the existing Nebula experience.
Projects.Requirements: Windows. Keep the entire game folder together. Astera installs the included launcher helper and runtime.
Projects.Notes:
Saving and stability improvements

- More reliable save checkpoints and recovery backups.
- Fixes for Studio scene loading and character placement.
- Less background rendering and unnecessary redraw work.

Projects.Title: Minecraft²
Projects.Summary: Your worlds. A little more alive.
Projects.Description:
Explore a reimagined Minecraft world, meet Allies who fight and grow alongside you, and face new dangers together. Build, survive, and create your own adventures.

You're not alone this time.
Projects.Requirements: Minecraft: Java Edition and CurseForge. Link a compatible Minecraft² profile in Astera to install or manage the pack.
Projects.Notes: See Minecraft² in your Library for the latest release notes.

Projects.Title: Star Dash
Projects.Description: Find Star Dash here and manage your existing installation in Astera.
Projects.Requirements: An existing Windows Star Dash installation. Link it in Library to play.

Projects.Title: FTL: Multiverse
Projects.Summary: Explore new sectors and adventures across the multiverse.
Projects.Description:
Explore new sectors, command powerful starships, encounter dangerous enemies, and discover countless adventures across the multiverse.

FTL: Multiverse is an external project. Astera helps you manage its installation alongside your existing FTL game.
Projects.Requirements: A supported Windows FTL: Faster Than Light installation. Astera checks the required mod components during setup.
Projects.Notes: Open FTL: Multiverse in your Library for official release notes when available.
